summary: Master the art of Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis. Join our training course to develop essential skills for effective problem-solving and safety.
lede: A safety incident inquiry reconstructs how an event occurred, while root cause analysis traces contributing conditions to support prevention. Designed for HSE investigation leads, reliability engineers, quality assurance managers and operations supervisors, the course develops practical skills in preserving evidence and examining failures. Learners practice witness interviewing, causal-factor charting and root cause methods, then use findings to analyze barriers and develop corrective and preventive actions.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for operational integrity, safety performance, and risk mitigation across high-stakes industries.
modules: Timeline Mapping and Causal Factor Charting
Human Factors and Systemic Failure Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in a safety, quality, or operational management role. A basic understanding of risk management principles is required. No prior experience with specific RCA software is necessary, though familiarity with incident reporting workflows is highly recommended.
